name: Hoa Lac High-Tech Park (HHTP)
sourceName: HHTP Management Board & NSO / Hanoi Investment Portal
verifiedNote: 3x63 MVA substation config (189 MVA; internal park summary also lists 320 MW regional capacity); 42,600 m3/day Column A wastewater capacity; 50–70 year lease term policy without single fixed expiry year.

name: Thang Long Industrial Park (TLIP I)
sourceName: Hanoi HPA & NSO / Sumitomo Corp Park Profiles
verifiedNote: 302 ha total (approx. 95% occupied; exact remaining ha unverified -> null); dedicated 110kV substation (exact MVA unverified for TLIP I -> null); 3,000 m3/day WWTP; operational term through 2047.

name: Quang Minh I & II Industrial Park
verifiedNote: Quang Minh I spans 344 ha (Quang Minh II adds ~266 ha); 110/22 kV substation reported as 60–125+ MVA range (kept null rather than picking midpoint); 3,000 m3/day WWTP Column A; lease term to 2053.

name: DEEP C Hai Phong I, II, III Industrial Zones
sourceName: HEZA / DEEP C & UNIDO GEIPP Vietnam Report
verifiedNote: 1,700 ha across Hai Phong zones (DEEP C I 541 ha, III 520 ha), 185 ha ready land; 626 MVA power capacity at DEEP C Hai Phong 1; 12,000 m3/day baseline WWTP (expanding to 20,000 m3/day).

name: VSIP Hai Phong Integrated Township & Industrial Park
verifiedNote: 1,600 ha master footprint (500 ha industrial + 1,100 ha urban township); ~200 MVA initial substation capacity (sources cite 200–210.9 MVA); 4,500 m3/day modular WWTP.

name: Trang Due I, II & III Industrial Park
sourceName: Trang Due IP / Kinh Bac City & InvestVietnam
verifiedNote: 401 ha Phases I–II + 687 ha Phase III (1,088 ha combined); 2x63 MVA (126 MVA) baseline substations; 5,000 m3/day initial WWTP (scaling toward 8,000+ m3/day).

name: Yen Phong I, Expansion & Yen Phong II-C Cluster
verifiedNote: Yen Phong I covers 658.71 ha (entire Yen Phong + II-C cluster >1,200 ha); four 110/22kV stations totaling 11x63 MVA (693 MVA); Phases 1+2 centralized WWTP total 40,000 m3/day.

name: VSIP Bac Ninh I & II Integrated Industrial Park
sourceName: VSIP Group / TDC Vietnam & NSO Profile
verifiedNote: VSIP Bac Ninh I is 700 ha (VSIP II adds 273 ha); dedicated 110/22kV 126 MVA station; 17,520–24,000 m3/day WWTP capacity; 50-year lease valid to 2057.

name: Da Nang High-Tech Park & Lien Chieu FTZ
sourceName: Da Nang Hi-Tech Park Board & GCG Infra
verifiedNote: 1,128.4 ha total, 140 ha ready land; initial 40 MVA 110/22kV Hoa Lien substation (upgradeable via dual 63 MVA); 18,000 m3/day total designed WWTP capacity; 50-year project policy.

name: Hoa Khanh & Lien Chieu Industrial Parks
verifiedNote: Hoa Khanh IP covers 394 ha (683 ha combined with Lien Chieu IP); 80 MVA internal 110/22kV grid (backed by 220kV Hoa Khanh substation); 5,000 m3/day WWTP; Expanded Hoa Khanh lease valid to 2054.

name: Amata Long Thanh High-Tech IP & Loc An - Binh Son IP
sourceName: DIZA Dong Nai & Sonadezi Long Thanh (SZL)
verifiedNote: Long Thanh IP ~488 ha (907 ha combined with Loc An - Binh Son); 115 ha available reported in combined cluster; 2x63 MVA (126 MVA); 10,000 m3/day baseline WWTP (up to 15,000–25,000 m3/day); lease to 2053.

name: Nhon Trach I–VI Mega Industrial Park Complex
sourceName: DIZA Dong Nai & Cushman & Wakefield / NSO
verifiedNote: Multi-zone complex (>2,700 ha overall); benchmark sub-zone metrics: Nhon Trach III ~688 ha & 14,000 m3/day WWTP, Nhon Trach VI 110/22kV 63 MVA substation; sub-zone lease terms run 2053–2058.

name: Saigon Hi-Tech Park (SHTP)
verifiedNote: 913 ha total across Phases 1–2; 220kV/110kV lines without verified park-wide MVA figure -> null; 5,000 m3/day WWTP (expandable to 20,000 m3/day); lease term to 2065.

name: Hiep Phuoc Port-Integrated Industrial Park
verifiedNote: 1,686 ha across 3 phases; 2x110kV substations cited broadly as 40–80 MVA range (kept null); 12,000 m3/day baseline Standard A WWTP (expandable to 18,000); Phase 1 to 2048, Phase 2 to 2058.

name: Chan May – Lang Co Economic Zone & Phu Bai IP
sourceName: Hue Portal / Kland & NSO Saigon-Chan May Profiles
verifiedNote: Saigon-Chan May IP sub-zone ~657 ha within 27,108 ha Chan May-Lang Co EZ; 2x80 MVA (160 MVA) 110/22kV station; 4,900 m3/day industrial WWTP; land lease term through 2078.

name: VSIP Can Tho (Vinh Thanh) & Tra Noc I, II
sourceName: Can Tho Portal / RSquare & Vietnam Industrial Hub
verifiedNote: 900 ha VSIP Can Tho master plan (Phase 1: 293.7 ha); dedicated 110kV substation under development (kept null); 6,000 m3/day Module 1 WWTP (expandable 12,000); lease term valid to 2072.
